<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>数据流图</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<noscript><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"></noscript>
<style>
:root {
  --bg-page: #f0f2f5; --bg-card: #ffffff; --bg-hover: #eef0f4; --bg-input: #f5f6f8;
  --border: #dde0e5; --border-light: #c8ccd3;
  --text-primary: #1a1d24; --text-secondary: #4a5568; --text-muted: #718096;
  --accent: #3b82f6; --accent-hover: #2563eb; --accent-light: rgba(59,130,246,.15); --accent-bg: rgba(59,130,246,.08);
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04); --shadow-md: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06); --shadow-lg: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100vh;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:var(--bg-page);color:var(--text-primary)}

.header{background:var(--bg-card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 24px;height:56px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;z-index:100;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.header-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary)}
.header-brand svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--accent)}
.header-badge{font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;background:var(--accent-bg);color:var(--accent);border-radius:20px;font-weight:500}
.btn{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:all .2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;font-family:inherit;user-select:none}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light)}
.btn svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:1px solid #c8ced6;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(59,130,246,.25)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:#5294fa}
.btn-primary:active{background:#1d4ed8}
.btn-secondary{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-secondary)}
.btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);border-color:var(--border-light);color:var(--text-primary)}
.btn-secondary:active{background:var(--border)}
.btn-danger{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#dc2626}
.btn-danger:hover{background:#fef2f2;border-color:#fecaca}
.btn-group{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.btn-group .sep{width:1px;height:14px;background:var(--border);flex-shrink:0}

.toast-container{position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:16px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.toast{padding:10px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateX(120%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);pointer-events:auto;max-width:400px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;line-height:1.5}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1}
.toast.success{background:#ecfdf5;color:#065f46;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;border-left:3px solid #10b981}
.toast.error{background:#fef2f2;color:#991b1b;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-left:3px solid #ef4444}
.toast.warning{background:#fffbeb;color:#92400e;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-left:3px solid #f59e0b}
.toast-close{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;opacity:.5;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:4px;color:inherit}
.toast-close:hover{opacity:1}

/*
 * ARCHITECTURE:
 *   .comfy-canvas          — viewport
 *     canvas#comfyGridCvs   — grid lines drawn in screen-pixel space (no scaling artifacts)
 *     .comfy-canvas-world   — transform: translate(panX, panY) only (GPU-composited pan)
 *       svg#comfyLinesSvg   — NO transform of any kind (would cache as texture → blur)
 *         g.comfy-conn-group → g.comfy-lines / g.comfy-labels
 *           path.comfy-line — d attribute holds PRE-SCALED screen coords (re-rendered on zoom)
 *           text.comfy-line-label — x/y/font-size all pre-scaled (re-rendered on zoom)
 *       .comfy-canvas-nodes — transform: scale(scale) → re-render on zoom changes for crisp text
 *         .comfy-node       — transform: translate(nodeX, nodeY) in world coords
 */

.comfy-canvas{contain:layout style paint;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;user-select:none;flex:1;min-height:0;background-color:#f8f9fb}
#comfyGridCvs{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.comfy-canvas.grabbing{cursor:grabbing}
.comfy-canvas-world{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:0;height:0;overflow:visible;will-change:transform}
/* transform: scale mode — re-render text at new size on big zoom changes.
   NOTE: nodesC.style.transform = scale() creates a compositor layer with
   a cached texture. _forceRerender (called from applyViewTransform) drops
   that cache on every zoom change so the browser re-rasterizes at the
   current scale. Without _forceRerender, text/borders would blur. */
.comfy-canvas-nodes{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;transform-origin:0 0}
.comfy-canvas-nodes .comfy-node{pointer-events:auto}
.comfy-lines-svg{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;overflow:visible}
/* shape-rendering: geometricPrecision tells the browser to prioritize
   geometric accuracy over speed when rasterizing paths — avoids the
   sub-pixel approximation that causes blur under transform scaling.
   text-rendering: geometricPrecision does the same for label text. */
.comfy-lines-svg path{shape-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.comfy-line-label{text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.comfy-line{fill:none;stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linecap:round;pointer-events:stroke;cursor:pointer;opacity:.6;transition:opacity .15s,stroke-width .15s}
.comfy-line:hover{opacity:1;stroke-width:3.5}
.comfy-line.selected{opacity:1;stroke-width:4;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(59,130,246,.55))}
.comfy-line.temp{stroke-dasharray:6 4;opacity:.8}
.comfy-line.s-blue{stroke:#5286F5}.comfy-line.s-cyan{stroke:#40CAD5}
.comfy-line.s-green{stroke:#2AC48E}.comfy-line.s-yellow{stroke:#EEBA45}
.comfy-line.s-orange{stroke:#EE8F45}
/* Connection label — sits on the line midpoint, layered above the path
   (labelsGroup is appended after linesGroup in _doRenderLines). The
   1px white stroke halo (paint-order: stroke fill) keeps the text
   legible where the line passes underneath. font-size transitions
   smoothly between default (10) and the selected/hover state (12). */
.comfy-line-label{paint-order:stroke fill;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1px;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:all;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:stroke-width .15s ease}
/* Selected / hover: thicker halo only — NO font-size change. The base
   font-size is set as an SVG attribute (10 * scale) in _doRenderLines
   so labels scale with zoom (matching node text). A CSS font-size here
   would override that attribute and break zoom scaling (label would
   stay fixed-size while everything else zooms). */
.comfy-line-label.selected,
.comfy-line-label.hover{stroke-width:2px}
.comfy-coord{position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:6px;z-index:50;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);background:var(--bg-card);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Inter',monospace;user-select:none;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .15s}
.comfy-coord:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent-light)}
.comfy-coord .coord-display{display:inline}
.comfy-coord .coord-inputs{display:none;white-space:nowrap}
.comfy-coord.coord-editing{user-select:text;cursor:default;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent-light);min-width:146px}
.comfy-coord.coord-editing .coord-display{display:none}
.comfy-coord.coord-editing .coord-inputs{display:inline}
.comfy-coord-input{width:38px;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text-muted);outline:none;text-align:right;user-select:text;vertical-align:baseline;line-height:1.4}
.comfy-coord-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--text-primary)}
.comfy-coord .coord-sep{margin:0 1px;color:var(--text-muted)}
.comfy-sel-overlay{position:absolute;border:2px dashed var(--accent);background:var(--accent-bg);pointer-events:none;z-index:100}

.comfy-node{position:absolute;background:var(--bg-card);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.18);box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06);cursor:default;transition:box-shadow .2s;user-select:none;z-index:2;will-change:transform;width:170px}
.comfy-node.dragging{transition:none;cursor:grabbing;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18);z-index:20}
.comfy-node:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.13)}
.comfy-node.selected{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.comfy-node-close{position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-10px;width:22px;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;color:#999;font-size:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;z-index:3;visibility:hidden;opacity:0}
.comfy-node:hover .comfy-node-close{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
.comfy-node-body:hover .comfy-node-close{visibility:hidden;opacity:0}
.comfy-node-close:hover{background:rgba(231,76,60,.12);color:#e74c3c;transform:scale(1.15)}
.comfy-node-close:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.comfy-node-header{height:34px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 14px;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;cursor:grab;user-select:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:1;transform:translateZ(0)}
.comfy-node-header:active{cursor:grabbing}
.comfy-node-header.h-blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5286F5,#4072E0);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.comfy-node.dragging .comfy-node-header{cursor:grabbing}
.comfy-node-header.h-cyan{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#40CAD5,#2FB7C2);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.comfy-node-header.h-green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2AC48E,#1AB17A);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.comfy-node-header.h-yellow{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EEBA45,#DBA731);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.comfy-node-header.h-orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EE8F45,#DB7C31);text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.comfy-node-body{height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary);min-width:0;overflow:visible;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px;border:none;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;position:relative}
.comfy-node-body:hover{background:var(--bg-hover)}
.comfy-node-val{flex:1 1 auto;overflow:hidden;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;text-align:left;min-width:0;max-width:none;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;max-height:2.7em;position:relative;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(128,128,128,.15) transparent}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar{width:2px!important;height:2px!important}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent!important;border:none!important}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(128,128,128,.15)!important;border-radius:1px}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(128,128,128,.3)!important}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar-button{display:none!important}
.comfy-node-val::-webkit-scrollbar-corner{display:none!important}
.comfy-node-empty{color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic;font-size:10px}
.comfy-node-clear{flex-shrink:0;margin-left:auto;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#bbb;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;visibility:hidden;transition:all .15s;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.comfy-node-body:hover .comfy-node-clear{visibility:visible}
.comfy-node-clear:hover{background:rgba(231,76,60,.12);color:#e74c3c}
.comfy-node-body.has-overflow::after{content:'…';position:absolute;left:124px;top:22px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--text-primary);background:transparent;padding:0 2px;pointer-events:none}

.comfy-socket{position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-card);border:2px solid;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:4;cursor:crosshair;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.comfy-socket:hover{transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.35);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(59,130,246,.35)}
.comfy-socket.dragging{transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.6);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(59,130,246,.5)}
.comfy-socket.in{left:-8px}.comfy-socket.out{right:-8px}
.comfy-socket.s-blue{border-color:#5286F5}.comfy-socket.s-cyan{border-color:#40CAD5}
.comfy-socket.s-green{border-color:#2AC48E}.comfy-socket.s-yellow{border-color:#EEBA45}
.comfy-socket.s-orange{border-color:#EE8F45}
.comfy-socket-inner{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.comfy-socket.s-blue .comfy-socket-inner{background:#5286F5}.comfy-socket.s-cyan .comfy-socket-inner{background:#40CAD5}
.comfy-socket.s-green .comfy-socket-inner{background:#2AC48E}.comfy-socket.s-yellow .comfy-socket-inner{background:#EEBA45}
.comfy-socket.s-orange .comfy-socket-inner{background:#EE8F45}

#inlineEdit{position:fixed;z-index:500;display:none}
#inlineEdit input{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;width:130px;outline:none;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
#inlineEdit textarea{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;width:180px;min-height:28px;outline:none;font-family:inherit;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);resize:vertical}

#ctx{position:fixed;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:4px;display:none;z-index:400;min-width:100px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
#ctx button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;font-family:inherit}
#ctx button:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-primary)}
#ctx .sep2{border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin:3px 6px}
#ctx .del{color:#dc2626}
#ctx .del:hover{background:#fef2f2}

#modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);z-index:300;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
#modal.on{display:flex}
#modalBox{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:20px;width:340px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
#modalBox h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px}
#modalBox label{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:3px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
#modalBox input,#modalBox textarea{width:100%;background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--text-primary);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px;font-family:inherit;outline:none;transition:.15s}
#modalBox input:focus,#modalBox textarea:focus{border-color:var(--accent);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light)}
#modalBox textarea{min-height:40px;resize:vertical}
#modalBtns{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}
#modalBtns button{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--text-secondary);transition:.15s}
#modalBtns button:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-primary)}
#modalBtns button.p{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
#modalBtns button.p:hover{background:var(--accent-hover)}

.layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh}
.canvas-wrap{flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0}

/* ── Custom color picker modal ── */
#cpModal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);z-index:400;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
#cpModal.on{display:flex}
#cpModalBox{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:20px;width:340px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
#cpModalBox h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px}
.m-cp-wheel-wrap{position:relative;width:fit-content;margin:0 auto;line-height:0}
.m-cp-wheel-wrap canvas{border-radius:50%;cursor:crosshair;display:block}
.m-cp-dot{position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,.35);pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.m-cp-preview{flex-shrink:0}
.m-cp-btns{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}
.m-cp-btns button{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--text-secondary);transition:.15s}
.m-cp-btns button:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-primary)}
.m-cp-btns button.p{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.m-cp-btns button.p:hover{background:var(--accent-hover)}

/* ── Modal color dots ── */
.m-dot{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;flex-shrink:0}
.m-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
.m-dot.active{border-color:#1a1d24}
.m-wheel-btn{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--border);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;overflow:hidden;position:relative;padding:0;flex-shrink:0}
.m-wheel-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
.m-wheel-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,hsl(0,70%,75%),hsl(90,70%,75%),hsl(180,70%,75%),hsl(270,70%,75%),hsl(360,70%,75%))}
.m-wheel-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:2px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
.m-wheel-btn svg{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:12px;height:12px;color:var(--text-muted)}

/* ── Node generation color picker dropdown ── */
#genColorDropdown{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.g-trigger-btn{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--text-secondary);transition:all .2s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font-family:inherit;user-select:none;flex-shrink:0}
.g-trigger-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);border-color:var(--border-light);color:var(--text-primary)}
#genColorPanel{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;margin-top:8px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);z-index:500;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s,visibility .15s}
#genColorPanel.open{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
#genColorPanel .g-panel-wheel{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--border);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;position:relative;padding:0;flex-shrink:0;margin:0 auto 10px;display:block;transition:transform .15s}
#genColorPanel .g-panel-wheel:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
#genColorPanel .g-panel-wheel::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,hsl(0,70%,75%),hsl(90,70%,75%),hsl(180,70%,75%),hsl(270,70%,75%),hsl(360,70%,75%))}
#genColorPanel .g-panel-wheel::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}
#genColorPanel .g-panel-wheel svg{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--text-muted)}
.g-dot-wrap{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.g-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;flex-shrink:0}
.g-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
.g-dot.active{border-color:#1a1d24}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="layout">
  <header class="header">
    <div class="header-brand">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5zM2 17l10 5 10-5M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>
      数据流图
    </div>
    <div class="btn-group">
      <div id="genColorDropdown">
        <button class="g-trigger-btn" id="genColorTrigger" title="选择生成节点颜色">颜色</button>
        <div id="genColorPanel">
          <button class="g-panel-wheel" id="gPanelWheel" title="自选颜色"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></button>
          <div class="g-dot-wrap" id="gColorDots"></div>
        </div>

<script>
// 节点颜色统一用 #RRGGBB 色值标注，不再用预设 ID
const PRESET_HEX = ['#5286F5','#40CAD5','#2AC48E','#EEBA45','#EE8F45'];
const DEFAULT_COLOR = '#5286F5';

const NODE_W = 170;
const GRID = 20;
// Connection test radius (world coords). When the temp line's end point
// is within this distance of a compatible socket's anchor, mouseup
// creates a connection. 14 = slightly generous vs the socket's 16px
// visual size, so the connection "clicks" even if the cursor is just
// off-center. In world coords, so the hit area scales with zoom.
const SOCKET_HIT_RADIUS = 14;

const WORLD_CENTER_X = 0;
const WORLD_CENTER_Y = 0;
const COL_X = [WORLD_CENTER_X - 300, WORLD_CENTER_X, WORLD_CENTER_X + 300, WORLD_CENTER_X + 600];
const START_Y = WORLD_CENTER_Y - 60;

const App = window.App = {
  canvasState: { nodes: [], connections: [], history: [] },
  dragState: null,
  isDragging: false,
  socketDragState: null,
  panX: 0,
  panY: 0,
  scale: 1,
  selectedNodeIds: new Set(),
  canvasPanState: null,
  canvasBoxState: null,
  canvasHistoryIndex: -1,
  _canvasHistoryMax: 50,
  _linesRaf: null,
  _lastRenderScale: 1,
  _forceRerenderPending: false,
  _modalNodeId: null,
  _inlineEditTarget: null,
  _ctxNodeId: null,
  _ctxConnKey: null,
  // Currently selected connection key (string "from___to") or null.
  // Single-selection: connections don't support multi-select. Clicking a
  // connection selects it (clearing any node selection); clicking a node or
  // canvas blank clears it. Delete key removes the selected connection.
  selectedConnKey: null,
  _customColors: [],
  _cpState: null,
  _cpEls: null,
  _cpOnConfirm: null,
  _wheelImageData: null,
  _selectedGenColor: null,

  /* DOM element cache */
  _nodeElMap: new Map(),
  /* Cached container dimensions */
  _cachedCW: 0,
  _cachedCH: 0,

  NODE_W: NODE_W,
  GRID: GRID,

  escapeHtml(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
  },

  /* ── Color helpers ── */
  hslToRgb(h, s, l) { s /= 100; l /= 100; const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l); const f = n => { const k = (n + h / 30) % 12; return l - a * Math.max(Math.min(k - 3, 9 - k, 1), -1); }; return { r: Math.round(f(0) * 255), g: Math.round(f(8) * 255), b: Math.round(f(4) * 255) }; },
  rgbToHsl(r, g, b) { r /= 255; g /= 255; b /= 255; const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b), l = (max + min) / 2; let h = 0, s = 0; if (max !== min) { const d = max - min; s = l > .5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min); switch (max) { case r: h = ((g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0)) / 6; break; case g: h = ((b - r) / d + 2) / 6; break; case b: h = ((r - g) / d + 4) / 6; break; } } return { h: Math.round(h * 360), s: Math.round(s * 100), l: Math.round(l * 100) }; },
  shadeColor(hex, amt) { let v = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16); let r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (v >> 16) + amt)), g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (v >> 8 & 0xff) + amt)), b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (v & 0xff) + amt)); return '#' + ((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b).toString(16).slice(1); },
  hexToRgb(h) { const v = parseInt(h.replace('#', ''), 16); return { r: (v >> 16) & 0xff, g: (v >> 8) & 0xff, b: v & 0xff }; },
  rgbToHex(r, g, b) { return '#' + ((1<<24) + (r<<16) + (g<<8) + b).toString(16).slice(1); },
  debounce(fn, ms) { let t; return function(...a) { clearTimeout(t); const c=this; t=setTimeout(()=>fn.apply(c,a),ms); }; },
  showToast(msg, type, dur) { type=type||'success'; dur=dur||3000; const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='toast '+type; const d=document.createElement('div'); d.textContent=msg; el.appendChild(d); document.getElementById('toastContainer').appendChild(el); requestAnimationFrame(()=>el.classList.add('show')); setTimeout(()=>{el.classList.remove('show');setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),300)},dur); },

  _resolveColor(c) {
    if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(c)) return { hex: c, shadeHex: this.shadeColor(c, -35) };
    return { hex: DEFAULT_COLOR, shadeHex: this.shadeColor(DEFAULT_COLOR, -35) };
  },

  _loadCustomColors() {
    try { this._customColors = (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('flow_custom_colors')) || []).filter(c => /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(c)); } catch(e) { console.warn('Failed to load custom colors:', e); this._customColors = []; }
  },
  _saveCustomColors() {
    try { localStorage.setItem('flow_custom_colors', JSON.stringify(this._customColors)); } catch(e) { console.warn('Failed to save custom colors:', e); }
  },

  _refreshContainerCache() {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (c) { this._cachedCW = c.clientWidth; this._cachedCH = c.clientHeight; }
  },

  getWorldPos(clientX, clientY) {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (!c) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (clientX - rect.left - this.panX) / this.scale,
      y: (clientY - rect.top - this.panY) / this.scale
    };
  },

  // ── Undo / Save ──
  saveCanvasSnapshot() {
    const snapshot = {
      nodes: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.canvasState.nodes)),
      connections: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.canvasState.connections))
    };
    if (this.canvasHistoryIndex < this.canvasState.history.length - 1) {
      this.canvasState.history = this.canvasState.history.slice(0, this.canvasHistoryIndex + 1);
    }
    this.canvasState.history.push(snapshot);
    if (this.canvasState.history.length > this._canvasHistoryMax) {
      this.canvasState.history.shift();
    }
    this.canvasHistoryIndex = this.canvasState.history.length - 1;
    this.updateCanvasUndoButtons();
    this.saveCanvas();
  },

  saveCanvas() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('flow_data', JSON.stringify({
        nodes: this.canvasState.nodes,
        connections: this.canvasState.connections,
        viewport: { panX: this.panX, panY: this.panY, scale: this.scale }
      }));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  },

  debouncedAutoSave: null,

  canvasUndo() {
    if (this.canvasHistoryIndex <= 0) return;
    this.canvasHistoryIndex--;
    this._restoreCanvasSnapshot(this.canvasState.history[this.canvasHistoryIndex]);
    this.updateCanvasUndoButtons();
  },

  canvasRedo() {
    if (this.canvasHistoryIndex >= this.canvasState.history.length - 1) return;
    this.canvasHistoryIndex++;
    this._restoreCanvasSnapshot(this.canvasState.history[this.canvasHistoryIndex]);
    this.updateCanvasUndoButtons();
  },

  _restoreCanvasSnapshot(snapshot) {
    this.canvasState.nodes = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot.nodes));
    this.canvasState.connections = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot.connections));
    this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas({ center: false });
  },

  updateCanvasUndoButtons() {
    const undoBtn = document.getElementById('undoBtn');
    const redoBtn = document.getElementById('redoBtn');
    if (undoBtn) undoBtn.disabled = !(this.canvasHistoryIndex > 0);
    if (redoBtn) redoBtn.disabled = !(this.canvasHistoryIndex < this.canvasState.history.length - 1);
  },

  // ── Canvas Events ──
  onCanvasMouseDown(e) {
    const container = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (e.button === 0 && e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (this.canvasBoxState) { this.finalizeBoxSelect(); return; }
      const wp = this.getWorldPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      this.canvasBoxState = { startX: wp.x, startY: wp.y, curX: wp.x, curY: wp.y };
      document.getElementById('boxSelectOverlay').style.display = 'block';
    } else if (e.button === 0) {
      // Clicking canvas blank (not on a node/line) clears connection selection.
      this._clearConnSelection();
      this._refreshContainerCache();
      this.canvasPanState = { startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, origPanX: this.panX, origPanY: this.panY };
      container.classList.add('grabbing');
    } else if (e.button === 1) {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._refreshContainerCache();
      this.canvasPanState = { startX: e.clientX, startY: e.clientY, origPanX: this.panX, origPanY: this.panY };
      container.classList.add('grabbing');
    }
  },

  finalizeBoxSelect() {
    if (!this.canvasBoxState) return;
    const lx = Math.min(this.canvasBoxState.startX, this.canvasBoxState.curX);
    const ly = Math.min(this.canvasBoxState.startY, this.canvasBoxState.curY);
    const rx = Math.max(this.canvasBoxState.startX, this.canvasBoxState.curX);
    const ry = Math.max(this.canvasBoxState.startY, this.canvasBoxState.curY);
    this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
    this.canvasState.nodes.forEach(n => {
      const nx = n.x || 0, ny = n.y || 0;
      if (nx + NODE_W >= lx && nx <= rx && ny + 80 >= ly && ny <= ry) this.selectedNodeIds.add(n.id);
    });
    this.canvasBoxState = null;
    const overlay = document.getElementById('boxSelectOverlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
    this.renderAssociationCanvas({ center: false });
  },

  onCanvasWheel(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const container = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left, mouseY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const oldScale = this.scale;
    const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.95 : 1.05;
    this.scale = Math.min(5, Math.max(0.15, this.scale * delta));
    const worldMouseX = (mouseX - this.panX) / oldScale;
    const worldMouseY = (mouseY - this.panY) / oldScale;
    this.panX = mouseX - worldMouseX * this.scale;
    this.panY = mouseY - worldMouseY * this.scale;
    this._refreshContainerCache();
    this.clampPan();
    if (this.canvasPanState) {
      this.canvasPanState.origPanX = this.panX; this.canvasPanState.origPanY = this.panY;
      this.canvasPanState.startX = e.clientX; this.canvasPanState.startY = e.clientY;
    }
    if (this.dragState) {
      const wp = this.getWorldPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      this.dragState.startWorldX = wp.x; this.dragState.startWorldY = wp.y;
      for (const n of this.dragState.nodes) {
        const cur = this.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === n.id);
        if (cur) { n.origX = cur.x; n.origY = cur.y; }
      }
    }
    // No special handling for socketDragState here — it stores world
    // coords (scale-invariant), so zoom doesn't invalidate it. The
    // renderLines call below will recompute the temp line at the new
    // scale automatically. This is the key benefit of data-driven
    // rendering: zoom-during-drag just works.
    this.applyViewTransform();
    this.renderLines();
    this.debouncedAutoSave();
  },

  // ── View Transform ──

  /*
   * KEY DESIGN: separate concerns for crisp text + performant panning
   *
   * 1. World div   → transform: translate(panX, panY)
   *    Moves everything during pan — GPU compositor, no re-layout.
   *    Pan does NOT change scale, so SVG paths (which hold pre-scaled
   *    coords) stay correct without re-render.
   *
   * 2. Nodes div   → transform: scale(scale)
   *    Force re-render on zoom changes to keep text crisp.
   *    Only updated on zoom change, not on pan.
   *
   * 3. SVG content → path `d` / label x/y hold PRE-SCALED screen coords.
   *    NO transform anywhere on the SVG side — neither CSS transform
   *    on <svg> nor SVG transform on a <g>. Both would cause the browser
   *    to cache the SVG as a GPU texture and stretch it on zoom (blur).
   *    Instead, renderLines() rewrites path geometry at the current scale
   *    every zoom change, so the browser rasterizes at 1:1 with pixels.
   */
  applyViewTransform() {
    /* 1. Pan: GPU-composited translate on world div */
    const world = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasWorld');
    if (world) world.style.transform = 'translate(' + this.panX + 'px,' + this.panY + 'px)';

    /* 2. Zoom: transform scale on nodes container, force re-render on big changes */
    const nodesC = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasNodes');
    if (nodesC) nodesC.style.transform = 'scale(' + this.scale + ')';

    /* Force re-render when zoom changes to keep text crisp. CSS transform:
       scale() on the nodes container rasterizes once and stretches the
       texture — text and borders blur. _forceRerender drops the cached
       texture so the browser re-rasterizes at the current scale. The
       threshold is small (0.02 = 2%) so even gentle scroll-wheel zoom
       keeps text crisp. */
    const scaleDiff = Math.abs(this.scale - this._lastRenderScale);
    if (scaleDiff > 0.02) {
      this._lastRenderScale = this.scale;
      this._forceRerender();
    }

    /* 3. SVG zoom — handled by re-rendering paths with pre-scaled
       coordinates in _doRenderLines (called by renderLines below).
       NO CSS transform on <svg>, NO SVG <g> transform — both would
       cause texture caching / sub-pixel blur. Instead, path `d` attrs
       hold final screen-pixel coordinates, so the browser rasterizes
       at 1:1 with the display. renderLines is throttled via rAF. */
    this.renderLines();

    /* 4. Grid (Canvas — pixel-perfect, no sub-pixel artifacts) */
    this._drawGrid();

    this.updateCoordDisplay();
  },

  /*
   * Grid drawn via Canvas 2D in screen-pixel space.
   * Lines are snapped to integer pixels — no anti-aliasing bleed,
   * no sub-pixel merging, no thickness flicker at any zoom level.
   * Minor grid (step=20) shown when spacing >= 8px; major grid (step=100) always shown.
   */
  _drawGrid() {
    const container = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    const cvs = document.getElementById('comfyGridCvs');
    if (!cvs) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const cw = container.clientWidth;
    const ch = container.clientHeight;
    if (cw === 0 || ch === 0) return;  /* layout not ready — will be retried */

    const bufW = Math.round(cw * dpr);
    const bufH = Math.round(ch * dpr);
    if (cvs.width !== bufW || cvs.height !== bufH) {
      cvs.width = bufW;
      cvs.height = bufH;
    }

    const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    const minorStep = GRID;  // 20
    const majorStep = GRID * 5;  // 100
    const minorScreenSpacing = minorStep * this.scale;
    const majorScreenSpacing = majorStep * this.scale;

    /* Major grid — always visible */
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,204,213,0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    const mFirstX = Math.floor((-this.panX / this.scale) / majorStep) * majorStep;
    const mFirstY = Math.floor((-this.panY / this.scale) / majorStep) * majorStep;
    for (let wx = mFirstX; ; wx += majorStep) {
      const sx = Math.round(wx * this.scale + this.panX) + 0.5;
      if (sx > cw) break;
      ctx.moveTo(sx, 0); ctx.lineTo(sx, ch);
    }
    for (let wy = mFirstY; ; wy += majorStep) {
      const sy = Math.round(wy * this.scale + this.panY) + 0.5;
      if (sy > ch) break;
      ctx.moveTo(0, sy); ctx.lineTo(cw, sy);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    /* Minor grid — only when lines are spaced >= 8px */
    if (minorScreenSpacing >= 8) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,204,213,0.35)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      const firstX = Math.floor((-this.panX / this.scale) / minorStep) * minorStep;
      const firstY = Math.floor((-this.panY / this.scale) / minorStep) * minorStep;
      for (let wx = firstX; ; wx += minorStep) {
        const sx = Math.round(wx * this.scale + this.panX) + 0.5;
        if (sx > cw) break;
        ctx.moveTo(sx, 0); ctx.lineTo(sx, ch);
      }
      for (let wy = firstY; ; wy += minorStep) {
        const sy = Math.round(wy * this.scale + this.panY) + 0.5;
        if (sy > ch) break;
        ctx.moveTo(0, sy); ctx.lineTo(cw, sy);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  },

  _forceRerender() {
    if (this._forceRerenderPending) return;
    this._forceRerenderPending = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this._forceRerenderPending = false;
      const nodes = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasNodes');
      if (!nodes) return;
      // Force the browser to re-rasterize the nodes layer. A simple
      // removeChild + insertBefore is NOT enough — the compositor often
      // keeps the cached texture. Toggling will-change forces a new
      // compositor layer to be created with fresh rasterization at the
      // current scale. We toggle it off again on the next frame so we
      // don't accumulate layers.
      nodes.style.willChange = 'transform';
      const parent = nodes.parentNode;
      const next = nodes.nextSibling;
      parent.removeChild(nodes);
      parent.insertBefore(nodes, next);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { nodes.style.willChange = ''; });
    });
  },

  updateCoordDisplay() {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (!c) return;
    const cx = Math.round((-this.panX + c.clientWidth / 2) / this.scale);
    const cy = Math.round((-this.panY + c.clientHeight / 2) / this.scale);
    const zp = Math.round(this.scale * 100);
    const elX = document.getElementById('coordX');
    const elY = document.getElementById('coordY');
    const elZ = document.getElementById('coordZ');
    if (elX && document.activeElement !== elX) elX.value = cx;
    if (elY && document.activeElement !== elY) elY.value = cy;
    if (elZ && document.activeElement !== elZ) elZ.value = zp + '%';
    const dispEl = document.getElementById('coordDisplay');
    if (dispEl) dispEl.textContent = cx + ', ' + cy + ' | ' + zp + '%';
  },

  _initCoordInputs() {
    const self = this;
    const coordEl = document.getElementById('comfyCoord');
    const elX = document.getElementById('coordX');
    const elY = document.getElementById('coordY');
    const elZ = document.getElementById('coordZ');
    const allInputs = [elX, elY, elZ].filter(Boolean);

    // Click on coord display -> enter edit mode
    if (coordEl) {
      // Prevent canvas pan when interacting with coord
      coordEl.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
      coordEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (coordEl.classList.contains('coord-editing')) return;
        if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
        coordEl.classList.add('coord-editing');
        self.updateCoordDisplay(); // refresh input values
      });
    }

    function endEdit() {
      if (coordEl) coordEl.classList.remove('coord-editing');
      self.updateCoordDisplay();
    }

    function onEnter(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); this.blur(); }
      if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (this === elX && elY) { elY.focus(); elY.select(); }
        else if (this === elY && elZ) { elZ.focus(); elZ.select(); }
        else if (this === elZ && elX) { elX.focus(); elX.select(); }
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); endEdit(); }
    }

    function checkEndEdit() {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!allInputs.includes(document.activeElement)) endEdit();
      }, 10);
    }

    function onXBlur() {
      let v = parseInt(this.value);
      if (!isNaN(v)) {
        v = Math.min(5000, Math.max(-5000, v));
        this.value = v;
        const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
        if (c) { self.panX = -v * self.scale + c.clientWidth / 2; self.clampPan(); self.applyViewTransform(); self.renderLines(); }
      }
      checkEndEdit();
    }
    function onYBlur() {
      let v = parseInt(this.value);
      if (!isNaN(v)) {
        v = Math.min(5000, Math.max(-5000, v));
        this.value = v;
        const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
        if (c) { self.panY = -v * self.scale + c.clientHeight / 2; self.clampPan(); self.applyViewTransform(); self.renderLines(); }
      }
      checkEndEdit();
    }
    function onZBlur() {
      const raw = this.value.replace(/[%％]/g, '');
      let v = parseInt(raw);
      if (!isNaN(v)) {
        v = Math.min(500, Math.max(15, v));
        this.value = v + '%';
        const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
        const newScale = v / 100;
        if (c) {
          const cxc = c.clientWidth / 2, cyc = c.clientHeight / 2;
          const oldScale = self.scale;
          self.scale = newScale;
          self.panX = cxc - ((cxc - self.panX) / oldScale) * newScale;
          self.panY = cyc - ((cyc - self.panY) / oldScale) * newScale;
          self.clampPan(); self.applyViewTransform(); self.renderLines(); self._drawGrid();
        }
      }
      checkEndEdit();
    }
    if (elX) { elX.addEventListener('keydown', onEnter); elX.addEventListener('blur', onXBlur); }
    if (elY) { elY.addEventListener('keydown', onEnter); elY.addEventListener('blur', onYBlur); }
    if (elZ) { elZ.addEventListener('keydown', onEnter); elZ.addEventListener('blur', onZBlur); }
  },

  /* Node click handler — supports Ctrl+click for multi-select */
  _nodeClick(e, nodeId) {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      if (this.selectedNodeIds.has(nodeId)) this.selectedNodeIds.delete(nodeId);
      else this.selectedNodeIds.add(nodeId);
    } else {
      this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
      this.selectedNodeIds.add(nodeId);
    }
    // Selecting a node clears connection selection.
    this._clearConnSelection();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas();
  },

  clearAllNodes() {
    if (this.canvasState.nodes.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm('将清空页面节点信息，是否继续？')) return;
    this.canvasState.nodes = [];
    this.canvasState.connections = [];
    this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
    this.selectedConnKey = null;
    this._nodeElMap.forEach(el => el.remove());
    this._nodeElMap.clear();
    this.saveCanvasSnapshot();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas();
    this.showToast('已清空所有节点');
  },

  /* Clipboard for copy/paste */
  _clipboard: [],

  updateNodePositions() {
    for (const node of this.canvasState.nodes) {
      const el = this._nodeElMap.get(node.id);
      if (!el) continue;
      if (typeof node.x !== 'number' || isNaN(node.x)) node.x = WORLD_CENTER_X;
      if (typeof node.y !== 'number' || isNaN(node.y)) node.y = WORLD_CENTER_Y;
      el.style.transform = 'translate(' + node.x + 'px,' + node.y + 'px)';
    }
  },

  clampPan() {
    const cw = this._cachedCW, ch = this._cachedCH;
    if (cw === 0 || ch === 0) {
      this._refreshContainerCache();
      if (this._cachedCW === 0 || this._cachedCH === 0) return;
    }
    const cw2 = this._cachedCW, ch2 = this._cachedCH;
    const ws = 10000 * this.scale, hs = 10000 * this.scale;
    const maxX = cw2 > ws ? cw2 / 2 : ws / 2;
    const minX = cw2 > ws ? cw2 / 2 : cw2 - ws / 2;
    const maxY = ch2 > hs ? ch2 / 2 : hs / 2;
    const minY = ch2 > hs ? ch2 / 2 : ch2 - hs / 2;
    this.panX = Math.min(maxX, Math.max(minX, this.panX));
    this.panY = Math.min(maxY, Math.max(minY, this.panY));
  },

  centerCanvasOnNodes() {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (!c || this.canvasState.nodes.length === 0) { this.centerCanvasOnOrigin(); return; }
    if (c.clientWidth === 0 || c.clientHeight === 0) { setTimeout(() => this.centerCanvasOnNodes(), 50); return; }
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    this.canvasState.nodes.forEach(n => {
      const nx = n.x || 0, ny = n.y || 0;
      if (nx < minX) minX = nx; if (nx + NODE_W > maxX) maxX = nx + NODE_W;
      if (ny < minY) minY = ny; if (ny + 80 > maxY) maxY = ny + 80;
    });
    const pad = 40, nodeW = maxX - minX, nodeH = maxY - minY;
    if (nodeW === 0 && nodeH === 0) {
      this.scale = 1;
      this.panX = c.clientWidth / 2 - minX - NODE_W / 2;
      this.panY = c.clientHeight / 2 - minY - 40;
    } else {
      const fitScaleX = nodeW > 0 ? (c.clientWidth - pad) / nodeW : 999;
      const fitScaleY = nodeH > 0 ? (c.clientHeight - pad) / nodeH : 999;
      const fitScale = Math.min(fitScaleX, fitScaleY);
      this.scale = Math.min(1.5, Math.max(0.3, fitScale));
      const cx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cy = (minY + maxY) / 2;
      this.panX = c.clientWidth / 2 - cx * this.scale;
      this.panY = c.clientHeight / 2 - cy * this.scale;
    }
    this._refreshContainerCache();
    this.applyViewTransform();
    this.renderLines();
  },

  centerCanvasOnOrigin() {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (!c) return;
    if (c.clientWidth === 0 || c.clientHeight === 0) { setTimeout(() => this.centerCanvasOnOrigin(), 50); return; }
    this.panX = c.clientWidth / 2 - WORLD_CENTER_X * this.scale;
    this.panY = c.clientHeight / 2 - WORLD_CENTER_Y * this.scale;
    this._refreshContainerCache();
    this.clampPan();
    this.applyViewTransform();
    this.renderLines();
  },

  // ── Render Canvas ──
  renderAssociationCanvas({ center = false } = {}) {

    if (!canvas) return;

    // Cancel any in-flight snap animations before re-rendering node positions
    // from data. This prevents a stale RAF from overwriting the freshly
    // applied transform from updateNodePositions().
    this._nodeElMap.forEach(el => { this._cancelSnapAnim(el); });

    let nodesContainer = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasNodes');

          '<span class="comfy-node-val">' + (node.desc ? self.escapeHtml(node.desc) : '<span class="comfy-node-empty">双击编辑</span>') + '</span>' +

    container.onmousedown = (e) => this.onCanvasMouseDown(e);
    container.onwheel = (e) => this.onCanvasWheel(e);

    this._initCoordInputs();
