  // ── Render Lines ──
  renderLines() {
    if (this._linesRaf) return;
    this._linesRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { this._linesRaf = null; this._doRenderLines(); });
  },

  // Clear connection selection and refresh line rendering. Returns true
  // if a selection was actually cleared (so callers can short-circuit).
  // Centralizes the 4 scattered "if (selectedConnKey) { null; renderLines(); }"
  // patterns that would otherwise live in canvas/node click / drag / delete.
  _clearConnSelection() {
    if (!this.selectedConnKey) return false;
    this.selectedConnKey = null;
    this.renderLines();
    return true;
  },

  // Wire up all interaction handlers for a connection's path or label.
  // Called ONLY at element creation. Uses dataset to find the paired
  // element at event time (not at bind time), so order of creation
  // (path before label or vice versa) doesn't matter, and we never
  // hold stale references across re-renders.
  _bindConnEl(el, k) {
    el.onmousedown = e => { e.stopPropagation(); };
    el.onclick = e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      this.selectedConnKey = k;
      this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
      this.renderLines();
      this._nodeElMap.forEach(n => { n.classList.remove('selected'); });
    };
    el.addEventListener('dblclick', e => { e.stopPropagation(); this.inlineEdit('edge', k); });
    el.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); this.showCtx(e.clientX, e.clientY, null, k); });
    // Hover → mirror .hover onto the paired element (path ↔ label).
    // Look up the sibling by dataset key at event time. Both path
    // (data-conn-key) and label (data-ck) share the same key value.
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      el.classList.add('hover');
      const paired = el.tagName === 'path'
        ? el.closest('svg').querySelector('text[data-ck="' + k + '"]')
        : el.closest('svg').querySelector('path[data-conn-key="' + k + '"]');
      if (paired) paired.classList.add('hover');
    });
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      el.classList.remove('hover');
      const paired = el.tagName === 'path'
        ? el.closest('svg').querySelector('text[data-ck="' + k + '"]')
        : el.closest('svg').querySelector('path[data-conn-key="' + k + '"]');
      if (paired) paired.classList.remove('hover');
    });
  },

  _doRenderLines() {
    const svg = document.getElementById('comfyLinesSvg');
    if (!svg) return;
    /* Initialise SVG size once; overflow:visible lets negative coords render */
    if (!svg.getAttribute('width')) {
      svg.setAttribute('width', '1');
      svg.setAttribute('height', '1');
    }

    // ── Data-driven line rendering ──
    // All line geometry is computed HERE from the current data + scale.
    // No intermediate state (no cached `d` strings, no pre-scaled coords
    // stored on socketDragState). Every render call reads the live data
    // and produces correct geometry at the current zoom. This is what
    // makes zoom-during-socket-drag work: the temp line's endpoint is
    // stored as a WORLD coord (scale-invariant), so zoom just triggers
    // a re-render that multiplies by the new scale.
    //
    // Coordinate system:
    //   - node.x / node.y        : world coords (data)
    //   - socketDragState.toX/Y  : world coords (data)
    //   - SVG path `d` coords    : world * scale  (pan is handled by
    //                            .comfy-canvas-world's translate transform)
    const s = this.scale;

    const connKey = c => c.from + '___' + c.to;
    let connGroup = svg.querySelector('.comfy-conn-group:not(.temp)');
    if (!connGroup) {
      connGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      connGroup.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-conn-group');
      svg.appendChild(connGroup);
    }
    // Two child layers guarantee z-order: paths first, labels second. SVG
    // paints later-appended elements on top, so labels always overlay the
    // lines — this is what makes "label on the line midpoint" readable.
    let linesGroup = connGroup.querySelector('.comfy-lines');
    if (!linesGroup) {
      linesGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      linesGroup.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-lines');
      connGroup.appendChild(linesGroup);
    }
    let labelsGroup = connGroup.querySelector('.comfy-labels');
    if (!labelsGroup) {
      labelsGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      labelsGroup.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-labels');
      connGroup.appendChild(labelsGroup);
    }

    const pathByKey = new Map();
    linesGroup.querySelectorAll('path').forEach(p => { const k = p.dataset.connKey; if (k) pathByKey.set(k, p); });
    const labelByKey = new Map();
    labelsGroup.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t => { const k = t.dataset.ck; if (k) labelByKey.set(k, t); });

    /* O(1) node lookup */
    const nodeMap = new Map();
    this.canvasState.nodes.forEach(n => nodeMap.set(n.id, n));

    // Helper: build a cubic-bezier `d` string from two world-coord endpoints.
    // The control points extend horizontally by half the horizontal distance,
    // producing the characteristic S-curve. All coords are pre-multiplied by
    // `s` so the path holds screen-pixel coords (crisp at any zoom).
    const buildPath = (wx1, wy1, wx2, wy2) => {
      const x1 = wx1 * s, y1 = wy1 * s, x2 = wx2 * s, y2 = wy2 * s;
      const dx = Math.abs(x2 - x1) * 0.5;
      return 'M' + x1 + ',' + y1 + ' C' + (x1 + dx) + ',' + y1 + ' ' + (x2 - dx) + ',' + y2 + ' ' + x2 + ',' + y2;
    };

    this.canvasState.connections.forEach(conn => {
      const k = connKey(conn);
      const fromNode = nodeMap.get(conn.from);
      const toNode = nodeMap.get(conn.to);
      if (!fromNode || !toNode) return;
      // Socket anchor points in world coords:
      //   out socket = right edge of source node (x + NODE_W, y + 40)
      //   in socket  = left edge of target node  (x, y + 40)
      const d = buildPath((fromNode.x || 0) + NODE_W, (fromNode.y || 0) + 40,
                          (toNode.x || 0),             (toNode.y || 0) + 40);
      const isSelected = this.selectedConnKey === k;
      const sw = 2.5 * s;
      const fromRC = this._resolveColor(fromNode.color);
      const pathCls = 'comfy-line' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '');
      const pathStyle = 'stroke:' + fromRC.hex;

      let path = pathByKey.get(k);
      if (path) {
        path.setAttribute('d', d);
        path.setAttribute('class', pathCls);
        path.setAttribute('stroke-width', sw);
        path.setAttribute('style', pathStyle);
        pathByKey.delete(k);
      } else {
        path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
        path.dataset.connKey = k;
        path.setAttribute('d', d);
        path.setAttribute('class', pathCls);
        path.setAttribute('stroke-width', sw);
        path.setAttribute('style', pathStyle);
        linesGroup.appendChild(path);
        // Bind events only at creation — re-binding every render would
        // leak listeners (addEventListener with fresh closures doesn't
        // dedupe). _bindConnEl looks up the paired label by dataset at
        // event time, so creation order doesn't matter.
        this._bindConnEl(path, k);
      }

      // Label position = exact midpoint of the line (screen coords).
      const midX = ((fromNode.x || 0) + NODE_W + (toNode.x || 0)) / 2 * s;
      const midY = ((fromNode.y || 0) + 40 + (toNode.y || 0) + 40) / 2 * s;
      let lbl = labelByKey.get(k);
      if (conn.label) {
        if (!lbl) {
          lbl = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
          lbl.dataset.ck = k;
          lbl.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
          lbl.setAttribute('font-size', String(10 * s));
          lbl.setAttribute('font-style', 'italic');
          lbl.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'middle');
          lbl.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-line-label');
          lbl.setAttribute('fill', '#4a5568');
          labelsGroup.appendChild(lbl);
          this._bindConnEl(lbl, k);
        } else {
          lbl.setAttribute('font-size', String(10 * s));
        }
        lbl.setAttribute('x', midX);
        lbl.setAttribute('y', midY);
        lbl.textContent = conn.label;
        lbl.classList.toggle('selected', isSelected);
        labelByKey.delete(k);
      } else if (lbl) {
        lbl.remove();
        labelByKey.delete(k);
        lbl = null;
      }
    });

    // Drop any path/label whose connection no longer exists.
    pathByKey.forEach(p => p.remove());
    labelByKey.forEach(p => p.remove());

    // ── Temp line (socket drag) — also fully data-driven ──
    // socketDragState holds: fromNode, fromDir, toWorldX, toWorldY.
    // All are world coords (scale-invariant). We compute the path `d`
    // here at the current scale, same as permanent lines. Zoom during
    // drag just triggers renderLines → this re-runs → correct geometry.
    const existingTemp = svg.querySelector('.comfy-conn-group.temp');
    if (existingTemp) existingTemp.remove();

    if (this.socketDragState) {
      const sd = this.socketDragState;
      const startX = (sd.node.x || 0) + (sd.dir === 'out' ? NODE_W : 0);
      const startY = (sd.node.y || 0) + 40;
      const d = buildPath(startX, startY, sd.toWorldX, sd.toWorldY);
      const tempGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      tempGroup.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-conn-group temp');
      const tempLine = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
      tempLine.setAttribute('d', d);
      tempLine.setAttribute('stroke-width', 2.5 * s);
      tempLine.setAttribute('class', 'comfy-line temp');
      tempLine.setAttribute('style', 'stroke:' + sd.colorClass);
      tempGroup.appendChild(tempLine);
      svg.appendChild(tempGroup);
    }
  },

  // ── Animations ──
  //
  // Frame-sequence snap animation with two independent refresh streams.
  //
  // Why not WAAPI / CSS transitions:
  //   An earlier implementation used el.animate() with fill:'forwards'. The
  //   animation visually overrode el.style.transform, but only wrote the final
  //   value back to el.style.transform inside its onfinish callback. If the
  //   user grabbed the node mid-animation, the WAAPI animation was cancelled,
  //   the visual snapped back to the (stale) pre-snap transform, while
  //   nodeObj.x/y already held the snapped target — producing a data/visual
  //   desync. The first mousemove then jumped the node to (snappedX+dx,
  //   snappedY+dy), manifesting as "flash back to the aligned grid" and a
  //   broken drag feel.
  //
  // Current design (frame sequence + two independent streams):
  //   1. On drag end, compute the nearest grid line for each node.
  //   2. Pre-compute a frame sequence — an explicit array of {x, y} positions
  //      sampled at 1ms granularity. This array is the "script" of the
  //      animation: every frame's target position is stored as data, not
  //      computed on the fly.
  //   3. Post-processing (overshoot, jitter, dance moves, etc.) is done by
  //      directly mutating this array. Adding an effect = editing the array.
  //   4. TWO INDEPENDENT STREAMS advance the animation:
  //
  //      DATA STREAM (setInterval @ 240Hz constant):
  //        - Frequency is a hardcoded constant (240Hz), independent of the
  //          browser's actual refresh rate. This is the key design decision:
  //          the animation's heartbeat is browser-independent.
  //        - Each tick: elapsed = performance.now() - startTime
  //                     idx = floor(elapsed / 1ms)
  //                     node.x/y = frames[idx]    (DATA ONLY, no DOM write)
  //                     animState.dirty = true
  //        - 240Hz covers all consumer displays (60/120/144/240Hz). On a
  //          60Hz browser, 3 out of every 4 data ticks are "wasted" (their
  //          values get overwritten before the next paint), but this is fine
  //          — the cost is just a few object property writes, and the
  //          guarantee is that node.x/y is always current when the browser
  //          does paint.
  //
  //      RENDER STREAM (requestAnimationFrame, vsync-bound):
  //        - Frequency = browser refresh rate (whatever it is).
  //        - Each tick: for each dirty anim, sync node.x/y → el.style.transform,
  //                     clear dirty, call renderLines() once (batched).
  //        - Does NOT advance the animation — that's the data stream's job.
  //        - If the browser drops a frame, this tick doesn't run, but the
  //          data stream keeps updating node.x/y. Next paint picks up the
  //          latest position. No animation slowdown.
  //
  //   5. Because the data stream uses time-based indexing (performance.now()),
  //      the animation ALWAYS takes 150ms regardless of the data stream
  //      frequency or the browser refresh rate.
  //   6. Interrupt handling: if the user grabs the node mid-animation, simply
  //      cancel (remove from active set, set cancelled flag). There is NO
  //      sync issue, because the data stream writes node.x/y on every tick
  //      and the render stream syncs it to DOM — node.x/y always equals the
  //      displayed position. The next drag starts from wherever the node was
  //      visually when grabbed.
  //   7. Both streams self-stop when _activeSnapAnims becomes empty. Idle =
  //      zero CPU. Background tabs: setInterval is throttled (browser-
  //      dependent, typically ~1Hz), so the data stream effectively pauses;
  //      RAF is also throttled. Both resume when the tab regains focus.
  //
  // Animation feel:
  //   150ms total: 100ms linear slide (start → target) + 50ms overshoot tail
  //   (target → 15% past target → target). The tail gives a subtle "bounce"
  //   feel without being exaggerated.
  //

  // Set of currently-active snap animations. Each entry is the animState
  // object also referenced by el._snapAnim. Using a Set (not an array) so
  // add/remove is O(1) and duplicates are impossible.
  _activeSnapAnims: new Set(),

  // ── Two independent refresh streams ──
  //
  // 1. DATA STREAM (setInterval, fixed 240Hz constant):
  //      Drives node.x/y updates. Frequency is a hardcoded constant (240Hz),
  //      independent of the browser's actual refresh rate. This guarantees
  //      the animation always advances at a smooth rate regardless of the
  //      display. 240Hz is chosen because it covers all consumer displays
  //      (60/120/144/240Hz) — even on a 240Hz screen, the data stream ticks
  //      at the same rate, so no frames are starved.
  //
  // 2. RENDER STREAM (requestAnimationFrame, vsync-bound):
  //      Syncs node.x/y → el.style.transform so the browser can paint it.
  //      Frequency = browser refresh rate (whatever it is). This stream
  //      doesn't decide WHEN the node moves — it only copies the latest
  //      data position to the DOM so the browser's next paint picks it up.
  //
  // Why split:
  //   - Data stream frequency is a constant → animation smoothness is
  //     browser-independent. A 30Hz throttled background tab still gets
  //     240 data updates per second (most are wasted, but the position
  //     is always current when the browser does paint).
  //   - Render stream follows vsync → no tearing, no wasted paints.
  //   - The two are decoupled: dropping the render stream (e.g. tab hidden)
  //     doesn't stop the data stream; the data stream can be cancelled
  //     without affecting the render stream's idle state.
  _snapDataInterval: null,        // setInterval handle for data stream
  _snapRenderRaf: null,           // requestAnimationFrame handle for render stream

  // Data stream frequency (Hz). Constant — never queried, never measured.
  // Higher = smoother animation on high-refresh displays, more CPU.
  // 240Hz covers all consumer displays without excessive CPU.
  _snapDataHz: 240,

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // FRAME-SEQUENCE ANIMATION (data-driven, decoupled from rendering)
  //
  // Design:
  //   1. _animateNodeToGrid pre-computes a frame sequence (an array of
  //      {x, y} positions) ONCE when the animation starts. This sequence
  //      is the "script" of the animation — every frame's target position
  //      is explicitly stored.
  //
  //   2. Post-processing (overshoot, jitter, easing, dance moves, etc.)
  //      is done by directly mutating/appending to this array. Because
  //      positions are explicit data, any effect is just an array edit —
  //      no function-logic gymnastics required.
  //
  //   3. _snapSchedulerTick advances the frame pointer based on elapsed
  //      wall-clock time (performance.now()), NOT by counting RAF ticks.
  //      This means the animation duration is fixed regardless of the
  //      browser's actual RAF frequency. If the browser drops frames,
  //      we just skip ahead to the correct frame for the current time.
  //
  //   4. Each tick writes BOTH node.x/y (data) AND el.style.transform (DOM).
  //      The data write is the source of truth; the DOM write is what the
  //      browser samples at vsync. They're kept in sync so that mid-
  //      animation interruption always sees data === visual.
  //
  // Why frame sequence (not a time function):
  //   - Explicit storage = debuggable. `console.log(frames)` shows the
  //     entire trajectory.
  //   - Post-processing = array edits. Adding overshoot = append a few
  //     frames. Adding jitter = offset each element. Adding a dance move
  //     = splice in a circle arc. All trivial, composable, inspectable.
  //   - The "frame rate mismatch" concern is a non-issue: we use time to
  //     INDEX into the array, so the array length doesn't need to match
  //     the actual refresh rate. Browser drops frames → we skip ahead,
  //     no slowdown.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  _animateNodeToGrid(el, node, worldX, worldY) {
    // Cancel any in-flight snap animation on this element first.
    this._cancelSnapAnim(el);

    // Read the current visual position from el.style.transform (this is the
    // true source of truth — WAAPI is no longer involved, so the style always
    // reflects what the user sees).
    const currentTransform = el.style.transform;
    const match = currentTransform.match(/translate\(([^,]+)px,\s*([^)]+)px\)/);
    const currentX = match ? parseFloat(match[1]) : worldX;
    const currentY = match ? parseFloat(match[2]) : worldY;

    // ── Data/visual sync at animation start ──
    // Callers (e.g. onUp) typically write node.x/y = snapTarget BEFORE
    // invoking this function, so at this moment we have a desync:
    //   node.x        = snapTarget (e.g. 100)
    //   el.style.transform = pre-snap visual position (e.g. 102)
    // If we let this desync persist, the next renderLines() tick (queued
    // by the caller right after this returns) computes line endpoints
    // from node.x = 100, jumping the connection line + label to the
    // snap target one frame early. Then the data stream's first tick
    // overwrites node.x = frames[0].x = 102, and the next renderLines()
    // jumps the line BACK to the start — manifesting as a single
    // "shake" on connection lines and labels while the node itself
    // stays still. Writing currentX/Y here makes data === visual at
    // animation start, so the data stream's first frame write is a
    // no-op and there is no visible discontinuity.
    if (node) { node.x = currentX; node.y = currentY; }

    // No distance to cover — pin to target and bail.
    if (Math.abs(worldX - currentX) < 0.01 && Math.abs(worldY - currentY) < 0.01) {
      el.style.transform = 'translate(' + worldX + 'px,' + worldY + 'px)';
      if (node) { node.x = worldX; node.y = worldY; }
      this.renderLines();
      return;
    }

    // ── Animation timing (in milliseconds) ──
    //   base phase (0 → baseMs): linear slide from start to target.
    //   tail phase (baseMs → totalMs): overshoot — target → peak → target.
    //   total = 150ms. Time is used to INDEX into the frame array, so the
    //   actual playback duration is always 150ms regardless of RAF rate.
    const baseMs = 100;
    const tailMs = 50;
    const totalMs = baseMs + tailMs;

    // ── Build the frame sequence ──
    // We sample the trajectory at a fixed granularity (one frame per
    // millisecond-step). This gives plenty of resolution for any refresh
    // rate (60Hz needs ~9 samples for 150ms, 240Hz needs ~36; we generate
    // 150 samples, so there's always a sample near the needed time).
    //
    // Why 1ms granularity: it's fine-grained enough that the scheduler can
    // always find a frame close to "where we should be right now", and the
    // array is small (150 elements = ~2.4KB). Going finer (e.g. 0.5ms)
    // wastes memory; going coarser (e.g. 16ms) would lose smoothness on
    // high-refresh displays.
    const sampleStepMs = 1;
    const dx = worldX - currentX;
    const dy = worldY - currentY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const ux = dx / dist;
    const uy = dy / dist;
    // Overshoot peak = target + 15% of (start→target) direction.
    const overshootAmount = 0.15;
    const peakX = worldX + ux * dist * overshootAmount;
    const peakY = worldY + uy * dist * overshootAmount;
    const peakRatio = 0.5; // peak at middle of tail

    const frames = [];
    for (let tMs = 0; tMs <= totalMs; tMs += sampleStepMs) {
      let x, y;
      if (tMs < baseMs) {
        // Base phase: linear start → target.
        const t = tMs / baseMs;
        x = currentX + dx * t;
        y = currentY + dy * t;
      } else if (tMs < totalMs) {
        // Tail phase: target → peak → target.
        const tailT = (tMs - baseMs) / tailMs; // 0..1 within tail
        if (tailT <= peakRatio) {
          const t = tailT / peakRatio;
          x = worldX + (peakX - worldX) * t;
          y = worldY + (peakY - worldY) * t;
        } else {
          const t = (tailT - peakRatio) / (1 - peakRatio);
          x = peakX + (worldX - peakX) * t;
          y = peakY + (worldY - peakY) * t;
        }
      } else {
        // Final frame: exactly on target (avoids float drift).
        x = worldX;
        y = worldY;
      }
      frames.push({ x: x, y: y });
    }

    // ── Post-processing hook ──
    // This is where you'd mutate `frames` to add effects like jitter,
    // dance moves, pauses, etc. The base trajectory is already complete
    // and valid; any post-processing is optional and composable.
    //
    // Example (NOT enabled — uncomment to play):
    //
    //   // Add ±2px jitter to middle frames, tapering at both ends
    //   for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    //     const envelope = 1 - Math.abs(2 * i / frames.length - 1);
    //     frames[i].x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * envelope;
    //     frames[i].y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * envelope;
    //   }
    //
    //   // Append a little dance at the end (3 small bounces)
    //   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    //     frames.push({ x: worldX, y: worldY - 4 * (1 - i/3) });
    //     frames.push({ x: worldX, y: worldY });
    //   }

    // ── Animation state ──
    // startTime is set lazily on the first data tick. The data tick uses
    // (performance.now() - startTime) to index into frames[], so playback
    // duration is always totalMs regardless of the data stream frequency.
    const animState = {
      frames: frames,            // explicit frame sequence (the "script")
      frameIndex: 0,             // current playback position
      startTime: null,           // set on first data tick
      totalMs: totalMs,          // total animation duration
      targetX: worldX,
      targetY: worldY,
      cancelled: false,
      node: node,
      el: el,
      dirty: false               // set true by data stream when node.x/y changes;
                                 // cleared by render stream after syncing to DOM
    };
    el._snapAnim = animState;

    // Register with the global scheduler. Start both streams if not already
    // running:
    //   - Data stream (setInterval @ 240Hz): advances frameIndex, updates
    //     node.x/y, marks animState.dirty = true.
    //   - Render stream (RAF): for each dirty anim, syncs node.x/y →
    //     el.style.transform, clears dirty.
    // Both streams self-stop when _activeSnapAnims becomes empty.
    this._activeSnapAnims.add(animState);
    if (this._snapDataInterval === null) {
      const intervalMs = 1000 / this._snapDataHz;
      this._snapDataInterval = setInterval(this._snapDataTick, intervalMs);
    }
    if (this._snapRenderRaf === null) {
      this._snapRenderRaf = requestAnimationFrame(this._snapRenderTick);
    }
  },

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DATA STREAM TICK (setInterval, 240Hz constant)
  //
  // This is the animation's heartbeat. It runs at a FIXED frequency (240Hz),
  // independent of the browser's refresh rate. Each tick:
  //   1. For every active animation, compute the current frame index from
  //      real wall-clock time (performance.now() - startTime).
  //   2. Update node.x/y to the frame's position (DATA ONLY — no DOM write).
  //   3. Mark animState.dirty = true so the render stream knows to sync.
  //   4. If the animation is complete, pin to target and remove from active set.
  //
  // Why data-only (no DOM write here):
  //   - DOM writes are expensive (trigger style recalc / layout). Doing them
  //     at 240Hz would waste CPU on overlapping writes the browser can't
  //     paint anyway (60Hz browser = 4 data ticks per paint; only the last
  //     write matters).
  //   - The render stream (RAF) runs at the browser's actual paint rate and
  //     picks up the latest node.x/y. This way we get 240Hz smooth data with
  //     only ~60Hz DOM writes.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  _snapDataTick: function () {
    const self = window.App;
    if (self._activeSnapAnims.size === 0) {
      // No active animations — stop the data stream (idle = zero CPU).
      clearInterval(self._snapDataInterval);
      self._snapDataInterval = null;
      return;
    }

    const now = performance.now();
    const sampleStepMs = 1;

    // Snapshot the set — animState.cancelled may be flipped during the loop
    // (e.g. by startNodeDrag grabbing a node), and Set iteration during
    // mutation is fragile.
    const snapshot = Array.from(self._activeSnapAnims);
    for (const anim of snapshot) {
      if (anim.cancelled) {
        self._activeSnapAnims.delete(anim);
        continue;
      }

      // Lazy-init startTime on the first data tick.
      if (anim.startTime === null) {
        anim.startTime = now;
      }
      const elapsed = now - anim.startTime;
      const idx = Math.floor(elapsed / sampleStepMs);

      if (idx >= anim.frames.length) {
        // Animation complete — pin node.x/y to exact target. Mark dirty so
        // the render stream does the final DOM write.
        if (anim.node) {
          anim.node.x = anim.targetX;
          anim.node.y = anim.targetY;
        }
        anim.frameIndex = anim.frames.length;
        anim.dirty = true;
        anim.el._snapAnim = null;
        self._activeSnapAnims.delete(anim);
        continue;
      }

      // Update data position from the pre-computed frame.
      const f = anim.frames[idx];
      if (anim.node) {
        anim.node.x = f.x;
        anim.node.y = f.y;
      }
      anim.frameIndex = idx;
      anim.dirty = true;  // tell render stream to sync this to DOM
    }
  },

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER STREAM TICK (requestAnimationFrame, vsync-bound)
  //
  // This runs at the browser's actual refresh rate. It does NOT advance the
  // animation — that's the data stream's job. This tick only:
  //   1. For every active animation marked dirty, sync node.x/y →
  //      el.style.transform, then clear dirty.
  //   2. Call renderLines() once (batched) so connection lines follow.
  //
  // If the browser drops a frame, this tick simply doesn't run that frame —
  // but the data stream keeps updating node.x/y, so the next paint picks up
  // the latest position. No animation slowdown.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  _snapRenderTick: function () {
    const self = window.App;
    self._snapRenderRaf = null;

    let anyDirty = false;
    const snapshot = Array.from(self._activeSnapAnims);
    for (const anim of snapshot) {
      if (anim.cancelled) continue;
      if (!anim.dirty) continue;

      // Sync data → DOM. Read the current node.x/y (already updated by the
      // data stream) and write to el.style.transform.
      const el = anim.el;
      const x = anim.node ? anim.node.x : anim.targetX;
      const y = anim.node ? anim.node.y : anim.targetY;
      el.style.transform = 'translate(' + x + 'px,' + y + 'px)';
      anim.dirty = false;
      anyDirty = true;
    }

    // If any animation was dirty, refresh connection lines once.
    // (renderLines self-coalesces via _linesRaf, so this is cheap.)
    if (anyDirty || self._activeSnapAnims.size > 0) {
      self.renderLines();
    }

    // Keep the render stream running while there are active animations.
    // When all animations complete, the data stream stops itself (see
    // _snapDataTick), and we stop the render stream here.
    if (self._activeSnapAnims.size > 0) {
      self._snapRenderRaf = requestAnimationFrame(self._snapRenderTick);
    }
  },

  // Cancel any in-flight snap animation on the given element.
  // After this returns, el._snapAnim is null and the element's transform /
  // node.x/y are guaranteed to be in sync (because the animation wrote both
  // on every frame, so whatever values are currently set are mutually
  // consistent).
  _cancelSnapAnim(el) {
    if (!el._snapAnim) return;
    const anim = el._snapAnim;
    anim.cancelled = true;
    // Remove from the global scheduler — it will skip this anim on its next
    // tick (or never see it if we delete now). Deleting now is O(1) and keeps
    // the active set tidy.
    this._activeSnapAnims.delete(anim);
    el._snapAnim = null;
  },

  // ── Node Drag ──
  startNodeDrag(e, nodeId) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    this.canvasPanState = null;

    /* Ctrl+click: toggle selection without clearing others */
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      if (this.selectedNodeIds.has(nodeId)) this.selectedNodeIds.delete(nodeId);
      else this.selectedNodeIds.add(nodeId);
      this.renderAssociationCanvas();
      return;
    }

    if (!this.selectedNodeIds.has(nodeId)) this.selectedNodeIds.clear();

    const nodeEl = this._nodeElMap.get(nodeId);
    if (!nodeEl) return;
    const node = this.canvasState.nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId);
    if (!node) return;

    // Cancel any in-flight snap animations on ALL nodes (not just the one
    // being grabbed) so that, e.g., a multi-node snap that is still running
    // when the user grabs a different node also stops cleanly. Because the
    // animation keeps node.x/y in sync with el.style.transform on every
    // frame, cancellation here leaves every node in a consistent state —
    // node.x/y is exactly the visual position. The new drag then starts
    // from wherever the node was visually when grabbed. No flash-back.
    this._nodeElMap.forEach(el => {
      el.style.transition = 'none';
      this._cancelSnapAnim(el);
    });

    // Grabbing a node clears connection selection (consistent with _nodeClick).
    this._clearConnSelection();

    const wp = this.getWorldPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);

    const nodesToDrag = [];
    if (this.selectedNodeIds.size > 1 && this.selectedNodeIds.has(nodeId)) {
      this.selectedNodeIds.forEach(sid => {
        const sn = this.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === sid);
        if (sn) nodesToDrag.push({ id: sid, origX: sn.x || 0, origY: sn.y || 0 });
      });
    } else {
      nodesToDrag.push({ id: nodeId, origX: node.x || 0, origY: node.y || 0 });
    }

    this.dragState = { nodeId, startWorldX: wp.x, startWorldY: wp.y, nodes: nodesToDrag };
    this.isDragging = true;
    nodeEl.classList.add('dragging');
    const self = this;
    let dragRafId = null;

    function onMove(e2) {
      if (!self.dragState) return;
      if (dragRafId) return;
      dragRafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        dragRafId = null;
        const wp2 = self.getWorldPos(e2.clientX, e2.clientY);
        const dx = wp2.x - self.dragState.startWorldX;
        const dy = wp2.y - self.dragState.startWorldY;
        for (const n of self.dragState.nodes) {
          const nodeObj = self.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === n.id);
          const newX = n.origX + dx, newY = n.origY + dy;
          if (nodeObj) { nodeObj.x = newX; nodeObj.y = newY; }
          const el = self._nodeElMap.get(n.id);
          if (el) el.style.transform = 'translate(' + newX + 'px,' + newY + 'px)';
        }
        self.renderLines();
      });
    }

    function onUp() {
      let positionChanged = false;
      if (dragRafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(dragRafId); dragRafId = null; }
      if (self.dragState && self.dragState.nodes) {
        for (const n of self.dragState.nodes) {
          const nodeObj = self.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === n.id);
          if (!nodeObj) continue;
          // Capture the CURRENT visual position BEFORE overwriting with the
          // snap target. The previous code compared snappedX to n.origX
          // (the position BEFORE drag), which meant dragging within a single
          // grid cell (e.g. 100→102, both snap to 100) would set
          // positionChanged = false and SKIP the animation entirely —
          // causing the node to teleport to the snap target with no visible
          // movement. This is the "near-teleport" bug.
          //
          // The correct comparison is: does the node need to MOVE from its
          // current visual position to reach the snap target? If yes
          // (even by 1px), the animation should run.
          const visualX = nodeObj.x;
          const visualY = nodeObj.y;
          const snappedX = Math.round(visualX / GRID) * GRID;
          const snappedY = Math.round(visualY / GRID) * GRID;
          // positionChanged = "the snap target differs from where the node
          // currently is". This is what determines whether an animation is
          // needed. Also gates saveCanvasSnapshot below — if the node is
          // already on the grid (no snap needed), no snapshot is warranted.
          if (snappedX !== visualX || snappedY !== visualY) positionChanged = true;
          nodeObj.x = snappedX;
          nodeObj.y = snappedY;
          const el = self._nodeElMap.get(n.id);
          if (el) {
            el.classList.remove('dragging');
            // Pass nodeObj so the animation can keep node.x/y in sync with
            // the visual position on every frame. This is what makes
            // mid-animation interruption safe.
            if (positionChanged) {
              self._animateNodeToGrid(el, nodeObj, snappedX, snappedY);
            } else {
              el.style.transform = 'translate(' + snappedX + 'px,' + snappedY + 'px)';
            }
          }
        }
      }
      self.dragState = null;
      self.isDragging = false;
      self._nodeElMap.forEach(el => { el.style.transition = ''; });
      self.renderLines();
      if (positionChanged) self.saveCanvasSnapshot();
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', onUp);
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    window.addEventListener('blur', onUp);
  },

  // ── Socket Drag (data-driven, minimal design) ──
  //
  // Data model (socketDragState):
  //   { nodeId, dir, colorClass, node, toWorldX, toWorldY }
  //
  //   - Start point = fromNode's socket anchor (computed live from node.x/y)
  //   - End point   = toWorldX/Y (world coords, updated on mousemove)
  //   - Influence   = bezier control point (computed live in buildPath)
  //
  // Nothing else is stored. The line shape is regenerated every render.
  // Connection test on mouseup: is the end point within SOCKET_HIT_RADIUS
  // of any compatible socket? Pure geometry, no DOM hit-testing.

  startSocketDrag(e, nodeId, dir, colorClass) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nodeEl = this._nodeElMap.get(nodeId);
    if (!nodeEl) return;
    const fromSocket = nodeEl.querySelector('.comfy-socket.' + dir);
    if (fromSocket) fromSocket.classList.add('dragging');

    const node = this.canvasState.nodes.find(n => n.id === nodeId);
    if (!node) return;

    const wp = this.getWorldPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    this.socketDragState = {
      nodeId, dir, colorClass, node,
      toWorldX: wp.x, toWorldY: wp.y
    };
    const self = this;

    function onMove(e2) {
      if (!self.socketDragState) return;
      const wp = self.getWorldPos(e2.clientX, e2.clientY);
      self.socketDragState.toWorldX = wp.x;
      self.socketDragState.toWorldY = wp.y;
      self.renderLines();
    }

    function onUp() {
      if (self.socketDragState) {
        const sd = self.socketDragState;
        // Connection test: does the end point fall within
        // SOCKET_HIT_RADIUS of a compatible socket on another node?
        const hit = self._findSocketHit(sd.toWorldX, sd.toWorldY, sd.nodeId, sd.dir);
        if (hit) {
          let fromId, toId;
          if (sd.dir === 'out' && hit.dir === 'in') { fromId = sd.nodeId; toId = hit.nodeId; }
          else if (sd.dir === 'in' && hit.dir === 'out') { fromId = hit.nodeId; toId = sd.nodeId; }
          if (fromId && toId && !self.canvasState.connections.some(c => c.from === fromId && c.to === toId)) {
            self.canvasState.connections.push({ from: fromId, to: toId, label: '' });
            self.saveCanvasSnapshot();
          }
        }
        if (fromSocket) fromSocket.classList.remove('dragging');
        self.socketDragState = null;
        self.renderLines();
      }
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', onUp);
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    window.addEventListener('blur', onUp);
    this.renderLines();
  },

  // Find a socket whose world-coord anchor is within SOCKET_HIT_RADIUS of
  // (wx, wy), excluding the source node and requiring opposite direction.
  // Returns { nodeId, dir } or null. Pure geometry — no DOM hit-testing,
  // so it works correctly at any zoom/pan.
  _findSocketHit(wx, wy, excludeNodeId, requireDir) {
    const r = SOCKET_HIT_RADIUS;
    for (const n of this.canvasState.nodes) {
      if (n.id === excludeNodeId) continue;
      // Socket anchor points (world coords):
      //   in  socket = left edge  (x,         y + 40)
      //   out socket = right edge (x + NODE_W, y + 40)
      const inX = n.x || 0,            sy = (n.y || 0) + 40;
      const outX = (n.x || 0) + NODE_W;
      if (requireDir !== 'in') {
        // Looking for an 'in' socket (source is 'out')
        const dx = wx - inX, dy = wy - sy;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) return { nodeId: n.id, dir: 'in' };
      }
      if (requireDir !== 'out') {
        // Looking for an 'out' socket (source is 'in')
        const dx = wx - outX, dy = wy - sy;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) return { nodeId: n.id, dir: 'out' };
      }
    }
    return null;
  },

  /* Copy selected nodes to internal clipboard */

    this._clipboard = [];
    this.canvasState.nodes.forEach(n => {
      if (this.selectedNodeIds.has(n.id)) this._clipboard.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n)));

  /* Paste nodes from clipboard — 平移到当前视口中心，保持剪贴板内节点相对布局 */
  pasteNodes() {
    if (this._clipboard.length === 0) return;
    // 剪贴板内节点的几何中心
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    this._clipboard.forEach(src => {
      const x = src.x || 0, y = src.y || 0;
      if (x < minX) minX = x;
      if (x + NODE_W > maxX) maxX = x + NODE_W;
      if (y < minY) minY = y;
      if (y + 80 > maxY) maxY = y + 80;
    });
    const cbCx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cbCy = (minY + maxY) / 2;
    // 视口中心对应的世界坐标
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    let vpCx = WORLD_CENTER_X, vpCy = WORLD_CENTER_Y;
    if (c && c.clientWidth > 0) {
      vpCx = (-this.panX + c.clientWidth / 2) / this.scale;
      vpCy = (-this.panY + c.clientHeight / 2) / this.scale;
    }
    const dx = Math.round(vpCx - cbCx), dy = Math.round(vpCy - cbCy);
    const idMap = {};
    const newIds = [];
    this._clipboard.forEach(src => {
      const id = 'n_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
      idMap[src.id] = id;
      this.canvasState.nodes.push({
        id, label: src.label + ' 副本', desc: src.desc, color: src.color,
        x: (src.x || 0) + dx, y: (src.y || 0) + dy
      });
      newIds.push(id);
    });
    /* Copy connections between pasted nodes */
    this._clipboard.forEach(src => {
      this.canvasState.connections.forEach(c => {
        if (c.from === src.id && idMap[c.to]) {
          this.canvasState.connections.push({ from: idMap[src.id], to: idMap[c.to], label: c.label });
        }
      });
    });
    this.selectedNodeIds.clear();
    newIds.forEach(id => this.selectedNodeIds.add(id));
    this.saveCanvasSnapshot();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas();
    this.showToast('已粘贴 ' + newIds.length + ' 个节点');
  },

  removeNodes(ids) {

    this.canvasState.nodes = this.canvasState.nodes.filter(n => !idSet.has(n.id));
    const removed = before - this.canvasState.nodes.length;
    if (removed === 0) return;
    this.canvasState.connections = this.canvasState.connections.filter(c => !idSet.has(c.from) && !idSet.has(c.to));
    // If the selected connection referenced a deleted node, drop the selection.
    if (this.selectedConnKey) {
      const parts = this.selectedConnKey.split('___');
      if (idSet.has(parts[0]) || idSet.has(parts[1])) this.selectedConnKey = null;

    ids.forEach(id => {

      const el = this._nodeElMap.get(id);
      if (el) { el.remove(); this._nodeElMap.delete(id); }
    });
    this.saveCanvasSnapshot();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas();
    if (removed === 1) { this.showToast('节点已删除', 'warning'); }

    };

    this._renderColorWheel();
    this._updateCpUI();

    const self = this;
    if (this._onWheelDown) this._cpEls.canvas.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onWheelDown);
    this._wheelMove = null;
    this._wheelUp = null;
    this._onWheelDown = function(e) {

      self._wheelUp = function() { if (self._cpState) self._cpState.dragging = false; if (self._wheelMove) document.removeEventListener('mousemove', self._wheelMove); if (self._wheelUp) document.removeEventListener('mouseup', self._wheelUp); self._wheelMove = null; self._wheelUp = null; };
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', self._wheelMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', self._wheelUp);
    };
    this._cpEls.canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onWheelDown);

    [this._cpEls.r, this._cpEls.g, this._cpEls.b].forEach(inp => {

    });

  cancelCustomPicker() {

    this._wheelUp = null;
    if (this._onWheelDown && this._cpEls) this._cpEls.canvas.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onWheelDown);
    this._onWheelDown = null;

  // ── Color wheel rendering ──
  _renderColorWheel() {
    const canvas = (this._cpEls && this._cpEls.canvas) || document.getElementById('mColorWheel');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (this._wheelImageData) { ctx.putImageData(this._wheelImageData, 0, 0); if (this._cpState) this._updateWheelDot(); return; }
    const size = canvas.width, cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2, r = size / 2;
    for (let a = 0; a < 360; a++) {
      const ra = a * Math.PI / 180;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, ra - .02, ra + .02); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'hsl(' + a + ',100%,50%)'; ctx.fill();
    }
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'white'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
    this._wheelImageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, size, size);
    if (this._cpState) this._updateWheelDot();
  },
  _updateWheelDot() {
    const s = this._cpState;
    if (!this._cpEls) return;
    const canvas = this._cpEls.canvas;
    const cx = canvas.width / 2, cy = canvas.height / 2, r = canvas.width / 2;
    const a = s.h * Math.PI / 180, d = Math.min(r, (s.s / 100) * r);
    this._cpEls.dot.style.left = (cx + Math.cos(a) * d) + 'px';
    this._cpEls.dot.style.top = (cy + Math.sin(a) * d) + 'px';
  },
  _updateCpUI() {
    const s = this._cpState, e = this._cpEls;
    if (!e) return;
    e.r.value = s.r; e.g.value = s.g; e.b.value = s.b;
    e.preview.style.background = s.hex;
    e.hex.textContent = s.hex.toUpperCase();
  },
  _cpFromRGB() {
    if (!this._cpEls) return;
    const r = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, +this._cpEls.r.value || 0));
    const g = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, +this._cpEls.g.value || 0));
    const b = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, +this._cpEls.b.value || 0));
    const hsl = this.rgbToHsl(r, g, b);
    const hex = this.rgbToHex(r, g, b);
    this._cpState = { h: hsl.h, s: hsl.s, l: hsl.l, r, g, b, hex, dragging: false };
    this._updateCpUI(); this._updateWheelDot();
  },
  _cpFromWheel(e) {
    if (!this._cpState || !this._cpEls) return;
    const canvas = this._cpEls.canvas;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = canvas.width / 2, cy = canvas.height / 2, r = canvas.width / 2;
    const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width, scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
    const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX, my = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
    const dx = mx - cx, dy = my - cy;
    const dist = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / r);
    let angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) * 180 / Math.PI;
    if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
    const rgb = this.hslToRgb(Math.round(angle), Math.round(dist * 100), 50);
    const hex = this.rgbToHex(rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b);
    this._cpState = { h: Math.round(angle), s: Math.round(dist * 100), l: 50, r: rgb.r, g: rgb.g, b: rgb.b, hex, dragging: true };
    this._updateCpUI(); this._updateWheelDot();
  },

  ctxDup() {

      id, label: src.label + ' 副本', desc: src.desc, color: src.color,

      this.canvasState.connections = this.canvasState.connections.filter(c => !(c.from === fromId && c.to === toId));
      // If the deleted connection was the selected one, drop the selection

      if (this.selectedConnKey === this._ctxConnKey) this.selectedConnKey = null;

  _getInlineInput() {
    const t = this._inlineEditTarget;
    if (!t) return null;
    if (t.type === 'nodeTitle' || t.type === 'nodeDesc') {
      const sel = t.type === 'nodeTitle' ? '.comfy-node-header' : '.comfy-node-val';
      const el = this._nodeElMap.get(t.id);

  saveInlineEdit() {
    if (!this._inlineEditTarget) return;
    const inp = this._getInlineInput();
    if (!inp) return;
    const val = (inp.value !== undefined ? inp.value.trim() : (inp.innerText || inp.textContent || '').trim());
    const { type, id } = this._inlineEditTarget;
    if (type === 'edge') {
      const parts = id.split('___');
      const fromId = parts[0], toId = parts[1];
      const conn = this.canvasState.connections.find(c => c.from === fromId && c.to === toId);
      if (conn) conn.label = val;
    } else if (type === 'nodeTitle') {
      const n = this.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === id);
      if (n) n.label = val || n.label;
    } else if (type === 'nodeDesc') {
      const n = this.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === id);
      if (n) n.desc = val;
    }
    this.closeInlineEdit();
    this.saveCanvasSnapshot();
    this.renderAssociationCanvas();
  },

  inlineEdit(type, id) {
    const el = document.getElementById('inlineEdit');
    const inp = document.getElementById('inlineInp');
    this._inlineEditTarget = { type, id };
    inp.style.display = 'none';
    el.style.display = 'none';

    if (type === 'nodeTitle' || type === 'nodeDesc') {
      const isTitle = type === 'nodeTitle';
      const sel = isTitle ? '.comfy-node-header' : '.comfy-node-val';
      const nodeEl = this._nodeElMap.get(id);
      const target = nodeEl ? nodeEl.querySelector(sel) : null;
      if (!target) return;
      const n = this.canvasState.nodes.find(nn => nn.id === id);
      if (!n) return;
      if (isTitle) {
        target.onmousedown = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
      } else {
        target.onmousedown = function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); };
        const body = target.closest('.comfy-node-body');
        if (body) body.onclick = null;
      }
      target.contentEditable = 'plaintext-only';
      target.style.outline = 'none';
      target.style.cursor = 'text';
      if (!isTitle) {
        target.style.whiteSpace = 'pre-wrap';
        target.style.setProperty('-webkit-line-clamp', 'unset');
        const body = target.closest('.comfy-node-body');
        if (body) { body.classList.remove('has-overflow'); }
        if (!n.desc) { target.textContent = ''; }
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        target.focus();
        const range = document.createRange();
        range.selectNodeContents(target);
        const selRange = window.getSelection();
        selRange.removeAllRanges();
        selRange.addRange(range);
      }, 0);
      const onKey = e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); this.closeInlineEdit(); this.renderAssociationCanvas(); }
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && isTitle) { e.preventDefault(); this.saveInlineEdit(); }
      };
      const onBlur = () => { if (this._inlineEditTarget?.type === type) this.saveInlineEdit(); };
      const onWheel = e => { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); target.scrollTop += e.deltaY; };
      target.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      target.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
      if (!isTitle) { target.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false }); }
      return;
    }

    inp.style.display = '';
    const inputEl = inp;
    inputEl.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;color:inherit;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;text-shadow:none';

    if (type === 'edge') {
      const parts = id.split('___');
      const fromId = parts[0], toId = parts[1];
      const conn = this.canvasState.connections.find(c => c.from === fromId && c.to === toId);
      if (!conn) return;
      const a = this.canvasState.nodes.find(n => n.id === conn.from);
      const b = this.canvasState.nodes.find(n => n.id === conn.to);
      if (!a || !b) return;
      const x1 = (a.x || 0) + NODE_W, y1 = (a.y || 0) + 40;
      const x2 = (b.x || 0), y2 = (b.y || 0) + 40;
      const mx = (x1 + x2) / 2, my = (y1 + y2) / 2;
      const cRect = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer').getBoundingClientRect();
      const sp = { x: mx * this.scale + this.panX + cRect.left, y: my * this.scale + this.panY + cRect.top };
      inputEl.value = conn.label || '';
      inp.style.width = '130px';
      el.style.left = (sp.x - 60) + 'px'; el.style.top = (sp.y - 14) + 'px';
    }
    el.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() => { inputEl.focus(); inputEl.select(); }, 10);
  },

  // ── Export / Import ──
  doExport() {
    if (this.canvasState.nodes.length === 0) { this.showToast('无数据可导出', 'warning'); return; }
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify({
      nodes: this.canvasState.nodes,
      connections: this.canvasState.connections.map(c => ({ from: c.from, to: c.to, label: c.label })),
      viewport: { panX: this.panX, panY: this.panY, scale: this.scale }
    }, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }));
    a.download = 'flow.json'; a.click(); this.showToast('已导出');
  },

  _validateLoadedData(data) {
    const nodeIds = new Set();
    data.nodes.forEach((n, i) => {
      if (!n.id || typeof n.id !== 'string') {
        n.id = 'n_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6) + '_fix' + i;
      }
      if (nodeIds.has(n.id)) n.id = n.id + '_dup' + i;
      nodeIds.add(n.id);
      if (typeof n.x !== 'number' || isNaN(n.x)) n.x = WORLD_CENTER_X + ((i % 4) - 1) * 300;
      if (typeof n.y !== 'number' || isNaN(n.y)) n.y = START_Y;
      if (!n.label || typeof n.label !== 'string') n.label = '未命名';
    });
    if (Array.isArray(data.connections) && data.connections.length) {
      const validIds = new Set(data.nodes.map(n => n.id));
      data.connections = data.connections.filter(c =>
        typeof c.from === 'string' && typeof c.to === 'string' &&
        validIds.has(c.from) && validIds.has(c.to)
      );
    } else {
      data.connections = [];
    }
  },

  doImport() {
    const inp = document.createElement('input'); inp.type = 'file'; inp.accept = '.json';
    inp.onchange = () => {
      const f = inp.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = () => {
        try {
          const d = JSON.parse(r.result);
          if (d.nodes && Array.isArray(d.nodes)) {
            this.canvasState.nodes = d.nodes;
            this.canvasState.connections = Array.isArray(d.connections) ? d.connections : [];
            this._validateLoadedData(this.canvasState);
            let newViewport = false;
            if (d.viewport && typeof d.viewport.panX === 'number') {
              this.panX = d.viewport.panX;
              this.panY = Number.isFinite(d.viewport.panY) ? d.viewport.panY : 0;
              this.scale = Number.isFinite(d.viewport.scale) ? d.viewport.scale : 1;
              newViewport = true;
            }
            this.canvasState.history = [];
            this.canvasHistoryIndex = -1;
            this.renderAssociationCanvas({ center: false });
            this.saveCanvasSnapshot();
            if (newViewport) this.applyViewTransform();
            else if (this.canvasState.nodes.length > 0) this.centerCanvasOnNodes();
            this.showToast('导入成功');
          } else {
            this.showToast('无效的存档格式', 'error');
          }
        } catch (err) { this.showToast('解析失败: ' + err.message, 'error'); }
      };
      r.readAsText(f);
    };
    inp.click();
  }
};

App.debouncedAutoSave = App.debounce(function() { this.saveCanvas(); }, 500);

// ── Global Events (rAF-throttled pan) ──
let _panRafId = null;
let _panLastEvent = null;

document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  if (App.isDragging) return;
  if (App.canvasBoxState) {
    const wp = App.getWorldPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    App.canvasBoxState.curX = wp.x; App.canvasBoxState.curY = wp.y;
    const lx = Math.min(App.canvasBoxState.startX, wp.x);
    const ly = Math.min(App.canvasBoxState.startY, wp.y);
    const rx = Math.max(App.canvasBoxState.startX, wp.x);
    const ry = Math.max(App.canvasBoxState.startY, wp.y);
    const overlay = document.getElementById('boxSelectOverlay');
    if (overlay) {
      overlay.style.left = (lx * App.scale + App.panX) + 'px';
      overlay.style.top = (ly * App.scale + App.panY) + 'px';
      overlay.style.width = ((rx - lx) * App.scale) + 'px';
      overlay.style.height = ((ry - ly) * App.scale) + 'px';
    }
  }
  if (App.canvasPanState) {
    _panLastEvent = e;
    if (!_panRafId) {
      _panRafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        _panRafId = null;
        const ev = _panLastEvent;
        if (!ev || !App.canvasPanState) return;
        App.panX = App.canvasPanState.origPanX + (ev.clientX - App.canvasPanState.startX);
        App.panY = App.canvasPanState.origPanY + (ev.clientY - App.canvasPanState.startY);
        App.clampPan();
        /* Only update world translate + grid (no zoom change) */
        const world = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasWorld');
        if (world) world.style.transform = 'translate(' + App.panX + 'px,' + App.panY + 'px)';
        App._drawGrid();
        App.updateCoordDisplay();
      });
    }
  }
});

document.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
  if (App.canvasPanState) {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (c) c.classList.remove('grabbing');
    App.canvasPanState = null;
    App.saveCanvas();
  }
  if (App.canvasBoxState) App.finalizeBoxSelect();
});

// Inline edit events
(function() {
  const inp = document.getElementById('inlineInp');
  let _blurTimer = null;
  function onKeydown(e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    clearTimeout(_blurTimer);
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && App._inlineEditTarget?.type !== 'nodeDesc') { e.preventDefault(); App.saveInlineEdit(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { App.closeInlineEdit(); App.renderAssociationCanvas(); }
  }
  function onBlur() {
    clearTimeout(_blurTimer);
    _blurTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (App._inlineEditTarget) App.saveInlineEdit(); }, 0);
  }
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
  inp.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
})();

// Context menu dismiss
document.addEventListener('click', () => { document.getElementById('ctx').style.display = 'none'; }, true);

// Modal events
document.getElementById('modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === this) App.closeModal(); });
document.getElementById('cpModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === this) App.cancelCustomPicker(); });

// Keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  const tag = (e.target.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
  const isEditing = tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || e.target.isContentEditable;
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'z' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); App.canvasUndo(); }
  else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === 'y' || (e.key === 'z' && e.shiftKey))) { e.preventDefault(); App.canvasRedo(); }
  else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'a') { if (!isEditing) { e.preventDefault(); App.selectAllNodes(); } }
  else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'c') { if (!isEditing) App.copyNodes(); }
  else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'v') { if (!isEditing) App.pasteNodes(); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape') { App.closeModal(); App.closeInlineEdit(); }
  else if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && !isEditing && !document.getElementById('modal').classList.contains('on')) {
    if (App.selectedNodeIds.size > 0) { App.removeNodes([...App.selectedNodeIds]); }
    else if (App.selectedConnKey) {
      const parts = App.selectedConnKey.split('___');
      const fromId = parts[0], toId = parts[1];
      App.canvasState.connections = App.canvasState.connections.filter(c => !(c.from === fromId && c.to === toId));
      App.selectedConnKey = null;
      App.saveCanvasSnapshot();
      App.renderLines();
    }
  }
});

// ── Init ──
(function() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('flow_data');
  let hasViewport = false;
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const d = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (d.nodes && d.nodes.length) {
        App.canvasState.nodes = d.nodes;
        App.canvasState.connections = d.connections || [];
        App._validateLoadedData(App.canvasState);
        if (d.viewport && typeof d.viewport.panX === 'number') {
          App.panX = d.viewport.panX;
          App.panY = Number.isFinite(d.viewport.panY) ? d.viewport.panY : 0;
          App.scale = Number.isFinite(d.viewport.scale) ? d.viewport.scale : 1;
          hasViewport = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }

  if (App.canvasState.nodes.length === 0) {
    const t = Date.now();
    App.canvasState.nodes = [
      { id: 'n_' + t + '_a1b2', label: '输入', desc: '数据输入', color: DEFAULT_COLOR, x: COL_X[0], y: START_Y },
      { id: 'n_' + t + '_c3d4', label: '输出', desc: '数据输出', color: DEFAULT_COLOR, x: COL_X[1], y: START_Y }
    ];
    App.canvasState.connections = [
      { from: 'n_' + t + '_a1b2', to: 'n_' + t + '_c3d4', label: 'data' }
    ];
  }

  App.renderAssociationCanvas({ center: false });
  if (hasViewport) App.applyViewTransform();
  else if (App.canvasState.nodes.length > 0) App.centerCanvasOnNodes();
  else App.centerCanvasOnOrigin();

  /* Ensure grid is drawn after layout is ready (retry until container has size) */
  (function _initGrid() {
    const c = document.getElementById('comfyCanvasContainer');
    if (c && c.clientWidth > 0 && c.clientHeight > 0) {
      App._drawGrid();
      App.saveCanvasSnapshot();
    } else {
      requestAnimationFrame(_initGrid);
    }
  })();

  /* Init generation color picker dropdown with hover buffer */
  const dd = document.getElementById('genColorDropdown');
  const panel = document.getElementById('genColorPanel');
  const pWheel = document.getElementById('gPanelWheel');
  let openTimer = null, closeTimer = null;
  function showPanel() { clearTimeout(closeTimer); if (!App._selectedGenColor) App._selectedGenColor = 'blue'; App._loadCustomColors(); App._buildGDots(); clearTimeout(openTimer); panel.classList.add('open'); }
  function hidePanel() { clearTimeout(openTimer); closeTimer = setTimeout(function() { panel.classList.remove('open'); }, 250); }
  dd.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { clearTimeout(closeTimer); openTimer = setTimeout(showPanel, 180); });
  dd.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) { if (e.relatedTarget && dd.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return; hidePanel(); });
  if (pWheel) pWheel.addEventListener('click', function() { App._gOpenCustomPicker(); });
  panel.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { clearTimeout(closeTimer); });
  panel.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(e) { if (e.relatedTarget && dd.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return; hidePanel(); });
})();

window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() { App.saveCanvas(); });
window.addEventListener('resize', function() { App.applyViewTransform(); });
</script>
